title: Number Of Pairs Of Interchangeable Rectangles
statement:
Two rectangles are interchangeable when their width-to-height ratios are equal. Given positive integer `[width, height]` pairs, return the number of index pairs `i < j` that are interchangeable.

## Examples

```text
Input: rectangles = [[4,8],[3,6],[10,20],[15,30]]
Output: 6
```

```text
Input: rectangles = [[4,5],[7,8]]
Output: 0
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= rectangles.length <= 10^5`
- Each rectangle has two dimensions in `[1, 10^5]`
